recipes.name: Lemon Pepper Wet inspired by Atlanta
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken wings, separated into pieces
1 tbsp lemon pepper seasoning (see below to make seasoning from scratch)
1/4 cup buffalo sauce (for JR Crickets version)
1/4 cup clarified butter (for American Deli version)
2 pounds chicken wings, separated into pieces
1 tbsp lemon pepper seasoning (see below to make seasoning from scratch)
1/4 cup buffalo sauce (for JR Crickets version)
1/4 cup clarified butter (for American Deli version)
instructions: Preheat frying oil to 350°F. Fry wings for 7-10 minutes, until golden brown and crisp. For JR Crickets version, toss with lemon pepper seasoning, followed by buffalo sauce. For American Deli version, toss with lemon pepper seasoning, followed by clarified butter. - 2 pounds chicken wings separated into pieces - 1 tbsp lemon pepper seasoning (see below to make seasoning from scratch) - ¼ cup buffalo sauce (for JR Crickets version) - ¼ cup clarified butter (for American Deli version) - 2 quarts vegetable oil

Combine kosher salt and baking powder, and sprinkle over wings. Toss until thoroughly coated, and place wings, far apart enough so that they’re not touching, on a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet. Refrigerate overnight, uncovered, and allow to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before baking at 450°F for 35-45 minutes, until brown and crisp. For JR Crickets version, toss with lemon pepper seasoning, followed by buffalo sauce. For American Deli version, toss with lemon pepper seasoning, followed by clarified butter. - 2 tsp kosher salt - 2 tsp baking powder - 2 pounds chicken wings separated into pieces - 1 tbsp lemon pepper seasoning (see below to make seasoning from scratch) - ¼ cup buffalo sauce (for JR Crickets version) - ¼ cup clarified butter (for American Deli version)

Set oven to lowest possible temperature. Spread lemon zest out on a parchment-lined baking sheet, and bake for 45-75 minutes, until completely dried. Pulse in a food processor until ground to granules, and whisk together with remaining ingredients. - 3 lemons zested - 2 tbsp pepper - 1 tsp sugar - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp celery salt
